## Fleet Specifications & Base Tariffs (Updated 2026)
All vehicles are air-conditioned, GPS-tracked, equipped with commercial yellow plates, and driven by uniformed, hill-certified drivers.

## Transparent Tariff Policy
- No Hidden Surges: Per-kilometer billing based on standard calibrated odometers.
- Driver Batta: Fixed per day (₹400 for Sedan, ₹500 for SUV, ₹600 for Tempo Traveller). Covers driver food & accommodation.
- Tolls, Parking & Interstate State Taxes: Billed transparently at actual government gate slips.
- Minimum Distance: Standard 250 km / 300 km daily minimum for outstation trips.
